properties.w: The Liao dynasty fell in 1125. In 1200 northern China was ruled by the Jurchen Jin dynasty, which this source does not draw.
The Buyid emirates ended in 1062. In 1200 this region was held by Seljuk successor states and the Khwarazmians.
